author: Facti0n
body:
ALL CREDIT GOES TO THE ORIGINAL MAP CREATORS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I'm only doing this as an experiment more than anything. I think that adding an ocn map to avicus that is unlicensed would be a good idea because if ocn players see an ocn map, they might want to stay and play. This was one of my personal favorite maps, and I think a lot of other ocn players liked it as it had very high reviews. I'm not even sure if this xml will work since it was created from the ocn documentation. 

Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?f882tyyz4asl3td
